name: arsenic trioxide + gelsemium sempervirens root + onion + strychnos nux-vomica seed
purpose: USES Temporarily relieves symptoms associated with hay fever.
uses: INDICATIONS ALLIUM CEPA Head cold ARSENICUM ALB Vomiting GELSEMIUM Lethargy NUX VOM Vomiting
otcwarn: STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR If symptoms persist or recur, discontinue use. If pregnant or nursing, consult a licensed practitioner before using this product.
